component.name: Deltiecord
component.summary: A compact, old-school Matrix desktop client

description.p: Deltiecord is a dense desktop client for Matrix with encrypted messaging, media, Spaces, and interoperable MatrixRTC voice and video rooms.
Repairs encrypted video playback and seeking, stabilizes timeline anchoring, refines notification ownership, and promotes Deltiecord's first stable-channel build.
Stabilizes timeline pagination, adds multi-link previews and optional FxTwitter rewriting, improves mobile media capture and actions, and repairs distributor-neutral Android push setup.

Stabilizes bidirectional timeline pagination, restores complete mobile media actions and date context, adds automatic update checks, and hardens UnifiedPush endpoint rotation and notification identities.
Fixes the v0.9.19 issue list, adds UnifiedPush and update checks, separates profile-cache refresh policies, and restores hardened image/video link previews.
Hardens timeline navigation, profiles, audio, categories, documentation, and desktop release packaging.
Adds context-aware profile cards and fixes bounded history pagination repeating pages.
Unifies lower panel geometry and adds resizable member sidebars plus a cleaner profile dialog.
Adds a collapsible server member panel and tightens desktop interaction and memory behavior.
Room context actions and a persistent direct-message recipient profile.
Discord-style floating composer and account control islands.
Unified lower strip, profile gradients, compact search, typography, and Space discovery fixes.
RTC audio controls, profile status and colour, navigation search, and theme cohesion.
Compact, vertically ranked emoji completion popup.
Profile image cropping and compact messaging presentation fixes.
Theme, profile, scaling, and timeline-density polish.
Desktop beta layout and presence polish.
